#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# lib/arms-common.sh — helpers shared by the two batch runners (cycle-130 Task 3.2)
#
# Sourced (never executed) by evals/harness/run-arms.sh (cycle-129 recall arms) and
# evals/harness/run-ablation.sh (cycle-130 ablation batches), each by the literal
# relative path ./lib/arms-common.sh after `pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR"` (eval.yml trust
# boundary: no variable on a source line, no .claude/ code). Extracted from
# run-arms.sh without behaviour change; evals/tests/run-arms.bats is the golden check.
#
# Functions:
#   usd_ok <v>                 0 when <v> is an amount in USD (1-6 digits, up to 4 decimals)
#   fadd <a> <b>               a + b, printed %.10g (awk)
#   json_array <v>…            the arguments as a compact JSON string array
#   is_transport_failure <ws>  run-arms layout: <ws>/.eval/{executor.json,agent-output.json,
#                              agent-stderr.log}; 0 when the executor failed for a transport
#                              reason (timeout exit 124/137/143, no result event, API error
#                              status, or a CLI transport message on stderr)
#   is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
#                              pipeline-run.sh layout: 0 when meta/pipeline.json says
#                              agent_error AND the failing phase (the last executed record
#                              with a non-zero exit, else the last executed record) shows a
#                              provider/transport signature: its transcripts/stderr-<label>.log
#                              matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE, or its events-<label>.jsonl holds a
#                              result event with a non-empty api_error_status, or an is_error
#                              result (the CLI's own error, never the agent's text) whose text
#                              starts "API Error" or matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE (a usage or
#                              session limit). Assistant messages are never read. A phase timeout is the
#                              model's own account (DEC-0417) and is never transport here.
#                              Prints the signature source (stderr | api_error_status |
#                              api_error_result) and the phase label on success.
#   est_record <key> <pool> <cost>   add one completed trial's cost to the key's and the
#                              pool's means (est_next's inputs)
#   est_next <key> [<pool>]    the next trial's expected cost: the key's mean, else the
#                              pool's mean (default pool "all"), else `est_hint <key>`
#                              (default: $COST_HINT; a runner may redefine est_hint)
#   spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
#                              charge one finished trial to SPENT: a trial that ended
#                              without status completed and without a reported cost is
#                              charged RUN_CAP (ASSUMED_CAP+1, logged); else its cost.
#                              Sets CHARGED_COST to the reported cost it accepted (0 for an
#                              assumed charge); call it directly, never in $( ), or SPENT
#                              is lost with the subshell
#   budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
#                              0 launch; 1 cut (CUT_JSON set). Waits (reap) while only the
#                              in-flight reservation (${#PIDS[@]} × RUN_CAP) blocks the launch
#
# Globals read: RUN_CAP, MAX_USD, COST_HINT, LAUNCHED, PIDS (array); written: SPENT,
# ASSUMED_CAP, CHARGED_COST, CUT_JSON, EST_KEYS/EST_SUM/EST_N, POOL_KEYS/POOL_SUM/POOL_N (parallel
# arrays: bash 3.2 has no associative arrays). The caller defines log and reap.
# =============================================================================

usd_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$ ]]; }
fadd() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", a + b }'; }
json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }

# The CLI's transport messages (audit r1 DISS-C-005: matched on the CLI's stderr only,
# never on the agent's own output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry
# by mentioning a network error).
ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE='rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]'

is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
  grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  return 1
}

is_pipeline_transport_failure() {  # is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
  local rd="$1" pipe="$1/meta/pipeline.json" label
  [[ "$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$pipe" 2>/dev/null)" == "agent_error" ]] || return 1
  label="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true)] as $r
                  | ([$r[] | select((.exit // 0) != 0)] | last // ($r | last) // {}) | .label // ""' \
           "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,15}$ ]] || return 1
  if grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$rd/transcripts/stderr-$label.log" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'stderr %s\n' "$label"; return 0
  fi
  local ev="$rd/transcripts/events-$label.jsonl" sig=""
  if [[ -f "$ev" ]]; then
    sig="$(jq -R -r --arg re "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "result")
                    | if ((.api_error_status // "") | tostring) != "" then "api_error_status"
                      elif .is_error == true and ((.result // "") | type) == "string"
                           and ((.result // "") | test("^API Error|" + $re; "i")) then "api_error_result"
                      else empty end' "$ev" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then printf '%s %s\n' "$sig" "$label"; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

# --- est_next inputs (completed trials only; assumed charges never enter) ---------
EST_KEYS=() EST_SUM=() EST_N=() POOL_KEYS=() POOL_SUM=() POOL_N=()
_est_find() {  # _est_find <EST|POOL> <key> → index or -1
  local i
  if [[ "$1" == EST ]]; then
    for i in ${EST_KEYS[@]+"${!EST_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${EST_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  else
    for i in ${POOL_KEYS[@]+"${!POOL_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${POOL_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  fi
  echo -1
}
est_record() {  # est_record <key> <pool> <cost>
  local i
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#EST_KEYS[@]}; EST_KEYS[$i]="$1"; EST_SUM[$i]=0; EST_N[$i]=0; fi
  EST_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${EST_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; EST_N[$i]=$(( ${EST_N[$i]} + 1 ))
  i="$(_est_find POOL "$2")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#POOL_KEYS[@]}; POOL_KEYS[$i]="$2"; POOL_SUM[$i]=0; POOL_N[$i]=0; fi
  POOL_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${POOL_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; POOL_N[$i]=$(( ${POOL_N[$i]} + 1 ))
}
est_hint() { printf '%s' "$COST_HINT"; }
est_next() {  # est_next <key> [<pool>]
  local i p
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"; p="$(_est_find POOL "${2:-all}")"
  if [[ "$i" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${EST_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${EST_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${EST_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  elif [[ "$p" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${POOL_N[$p]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${POOL_SUM[$p]}" -v n="${POOL_N[$p]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  else est_hint "$1"; fi
}

spend_charge() {  # spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
  local st="$1" cost="$2" what="$3"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
  if [[ "$st" != "completed" ]] && awk -v c="$cost" 'BEGIN { exit !(c + 0 == 0) }'; then
    # audit MEDIUM-A2: a failed trial that reports no cost is charged the run cap
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "assumed cap: $what ended ${st:-without a status} with no reported cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    CHARGED_COST=0
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    CHARGED_COST="$cost"
  fi
}

budget_gate() {  # budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
  local key="$1" at="$2" pool="${3:-all}" est inflight reserved
  while true; do
    est="$(est_next "$key" "$pool")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}
    reserved="$(awk -v k="$inflight" -v c="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", k * c }')"
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + e > m) }'; then
      CUT_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg s "$SPENT" --arg r "$reserved" --arg m "$MAX_USD" --arg e "$est" \
        --argjson launched "$LAUNCHED" --argjson at "$at" \
        '{reason: "max_usd", spent: ($s | tonumber), in_flight_reserved: ($r | tonumber), max: ($m | tonumber),
          est_next: ($e | tonumber), trials_launched: $launched, at_trial: $at}')"
      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"
      return 1
    fi
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v r="$reserved" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + r + e > m) }'; then
      reap "$inflight"; continue
    fi
    return 0
  done
}

#
# Sourced (never executed) by evals/harness/run-arms.sh (cycle-129 recall arms) and
# evals/harness/run-ablation.sh (cycle-130 ablation batches), each by the literal
# relative path ./lib/arms-common.sh after `pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR"` (eval.yml trust
# boundary: no variable on a source line, no .claude/ code). Extracted from
# run-arms.sh without behaviour change; evals/tests/run-arms.bats is the golden check.
#
# Functions:
#   usd_ok <v>                 0 when <v> is an amount in USD (1-6 digits, up to 4 decimals)
#   fadd <a> <b>               a + b, printed %.10g (awk)
#   json_array <v>…            the arguments as a compact JSON string array
#   is_transport_failure <ws>  run-arms layout: <ws>/.eval/{executor.json,agent-output.json,
#                              agent-stderr.log}; 0 when the executor failed for a transport
#                              reason (timeout exit 124/137/143, no result event, API error
#                              status, or a CLI transport message on stderr)
#   is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
#                              pipeline-run.sh layout: 0 when meta/pipeline.json says
#                              agent_error AND the failing phase (the last executed record
#                              with a non-zero exit, else the last executed record) shows a
#                              provider/transport signature: its transcripts/stderr-<label>.log
#                              matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE, or its events-<label>.jsonl holds a
#                              result event with a non-empty api_error_status, or an is_error
#                              result (the CLI's own error, never the agent's text) whose text
#                              starts "API Error" or matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE (a usage or
#                              session limit). Assistant messages are never read. A phase timeout is the
#                              model's own account (DEC-0417) and is never transport here.
#                              Prints the signature source (stderr | api_error_status |
#                              api_error_result) and the phase label on success.
#   est_record <key> <pool> <cost>   add one completed trial's cost to the key's and the
#                              pool's means (est_next's inputs)
#   est_next <key> [<pool>]    the next trial's expected cost: the key's mean, else the
#                              pool's mean (default pool "all"), else `est_hint <key>`
#                              (default: $COST_HINT; a runner may redefine est_hint)
#   spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
#                              charge one finished trial to SPENT: a trial that ended
#                              without status completed and without a reported cost is
#                              charged RUN_CAP (ASSUMED_CAP+1, logged); else its cost.
#                              Sets CHARGED_COST to the reported cost it accepted (0 for an
#                              assumed charge); call it directly, never in $( ), or SPENT
#                              is lost with the subshell
#   budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
#                              0 launch; 1 cut (CUT_JSON set). Waits (reap) while only the
#                              in-flight reservation (${#PIDS[@]} × RUN_CAP) blocks the launch
#
# Globals read: RUN_CAP, MAX_USD, COST_HINT, LAUNCHED, PIDS (array); written: SPENT,
# ASSUMED_CAP, CHARGED_COST, CUT_JSON, EST_KEYS/EST_SUM/EST_N, POOL_KEYS/POOL_SUM/POOL_N (parallel
# arrays: bash 3.2 has no associative arrays). The caller defines log and reap.
# =============================================================================

usd_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$ ]]; }
fadd() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", a + b }'; }
json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }

# The CLI's transport messages (audit r1 DISS-C-005: matched on the CLI's stderr only,
# never on the agent's own output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry
# by mentioning a network error).
ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE='rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]'

is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
  grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  return 1
}

is_pipeline_transport_failure() {  # is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
  local rd="$1" pipe="$1/meta/pipeline.json" label
  [[ "$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$pipe" 2>/dev/null)" == "agent_error" ]] || return 1
  label="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true)] as $r
                  | ([$r[] | select((.exit // 0) != 0)] | last // ($r | last) // {}) | .label // ""' \
           "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,15}$ ]] || return 1
  if grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$rd/transcripts/stderr-$label.log" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'stderr %s\n' "$label"; return 0
  fi
  local ev="$rd/transcripts/events-$label.jsonl" sig=""
  if [[ -f "$ev" ]]; then
    sig="$(jq -R -r --arg re "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "result")
                    | if ((.api_error_status // "") | tostring) != "" then "api_error_status"
                      elif .is_error == true and ((.result // "") | type) == "string"
                           and ((.result // "") | test("^API Error|" + $re; "i")) then "api_error_result"
                      else empty end' "$ev" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then printf '%s %s\n' "$sig" "$label"; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

# --- est_next inputs (completed trials only; assumed charges never enter) ---------
EST_KEYS=() EST_SUM=() EST_N=() POOL_KEYS=() POOL_SUM=() POOL_N=()
_est_find() {  # _est_find <EST|POOL> <key> → index or -1
  local i
  if [[ "$1" == EST ]]; then
    for i in ${EST_KEYS[@]+"${!EST_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${EST_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  else
    for i in ${POOL_KEYS[@]+"${!POOL_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${POOL_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  fi
  echo -1
}
est_record() {  # est_record <key> <pool> <cost>
  local i
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#EST_KEYS[@]}; EST_KEYS[$i]="$1"; EST_SUM[$i]=0; EST_N[$i]=0; fi
  EST_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${EST_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; EST_N[$i]=$(( ${EST_N[$i]} + 1 ))
  i="$(_est_find POOL "$2")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#POOL_KEYS[@]}; POOL_KEYS[$i]="$2"; POOL_SUM[$i]=0; POOL_N[$i]=0; fi
  POOL_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${POOL_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; POOL_N[$i]=$(( ${POOL_N[$i]} + 1 ))
}
est_hint() { printf '%s' "$COST_HINT"; }
est_next() {  # est_next <key> [<pool>]
  local i p
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"; p="$(_est_find POOL "${2:-all}")"
  if [[ "$i" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${EST_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${EST_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${EST_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  elif [[ "$p" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${POOL_N[$p]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${POOL_SUM[$p]}" -v n="${POOL_N[$p]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  else est_hint "$1"; fi
}

spend_charge() {  # spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
  local st="$1" cost="$2" what="$3"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
  if [[ "$st" != "completed" ]] && awk -v c="$cost" 'BEGIN { exit !(c + 0 == 0) }'; then
    # audit MEDIUM-A2: a failed trial that reports no cost is charged the run cap
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "assumed cap: $what ended ${st:-without a status} with no reported cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    CHARGED_COST=0
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    CHARGED_COST="$cost"
  fi
}

budget_gate() {  # budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
  local key="$1" at="$2" pool="${3:-all}" est inflight reserved
  while true; do
    est="$(est_next "$key" "$pool")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}
    reserved="$(awk -v k="$inflight" -v c="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", k * c }')"
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + e > m) }'; then
      CUT_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg s "$SPENT" --arg r "$reserved" --arg m "$MAX_USD" --arg e "$est" \
        --argjson launched "$LAUNCHED" --argjson at "$at" \
        '{reason: "max_usd", spent: ($s | tonumber), in_flight_reserved: ($r | tonumber), max: ($m | tonumber),
          est_next: ($e | tonumber), trials_launched: $launched, at_trial: $at}')"
      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"
      return 1
    fi
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v r="$reserved" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + r + e > m) }'; then
      reap "$inflight"; continue
    fi
    return 0
  done
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# =============================================================================
# ablation-report.py — the cycle-130 ablation report (PRD FR-8, SDD §5.12, §4.2)
#
# Reads runs.jsonl rows (SDD §3.1, ablation-row.sh), the batch MANIFEST.json files
# (SDD §3.4, run-ablation.sh) and the suite file (evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:
# arms[], trials, cut_ladder, priority and the pre-registered `rules` block, D-A5),
# applies the pre-registered rules to every component arm (A2 … A7) against the
# control a1_full, checks H1 (a1_full vs a0_bare) and the A4 sensitivity rule, and
# writes report.md (and a --json twin with the same numbers).
#
# Usage:
#   ablation-report.py --runs F [--runs F ...] --manifests DIR [--manifests DIR ...]
#                      --suite F --out report.md [--json report.json]
#                      [--seed 20261015] [--resamples N] [--level L]
#                      [--exclude-degraded true|false] [--partial]
#                      [--cuts F] [--not-run CSV]
#
# Options:
#   --runs F            a runs.jsonl file (repeatable). Every non-blank line is one row
#                       and must carry schema_version 1 (an integer, or a "1.x" string);
#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).
#   --manifests DIR     a directory searched recursively (symlinks not followed) for
#                       MANIFEST.json files (repeatable). Each gives a batch's provenance:
#                       batch, arm_map, shuffle_seed, source_commit, suite_manifest_sha256,
#                       suite_version, pre_registration_ref, cli_version (top level or
#                       executor.cli_version), image_digest, smoke. A manifest with an
#                       unknown schema_version major, two manifests claiming one batch, or
#                       an arm_map entry disagreeing with a row's arm → exit 2.
#   --suite F           the suite file: YAML read through `yq -o=json` (mikefarah yq v4,
#                       as arms-report.py does), or JSON when the file parses as JSON.
#                       The Method section quotes its `rules:` block verbatim.
#   --out F             report.md (the only files written are --out and --json; a symlink
#                       at either path is refused)
#   --json F            the JSON twin (schema_version 1)
#   --seed N            bootstrap seed (default 20261015); every interval uses its own
#                       random.Random(seed), so a figure does not depend on which other
#                       arms are present
#   --resamples N       default rules.bootstrap.resamples (10,000); a value other than the
#                       pre-registered one is marked in the header
#   --level L           default rules.bootstrap.level (0.90); same marking
#   --exclude-degraded  true (default) | false: rows with degraded: true are excluded
#                       pairwise (rules.exclusion.statuses names `degraded`)
#   --partial           prints "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"; exit 1 when no
#                       comparison (A2–A7, H1, A4) has a valid pair on every primary it uses
#   --cuts F            a JSON list of {arm, reason, figure[, state]} the lead recorded;
#                       arm is an id (a5_no_flatline) or a label (A5); state is not_run_cut
#                       (default) or inconclusive_by_power (a pre-declared power cut)
#   --not-run CSV       arm ids or labels read as Not run (cut) with figure "--not-run"
#
# Row treatment (DEC-0393, DEC-0417):
#   not decided, listed  rows of a smoke batch (manifest smoke: true), rows whose batch has
#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)
#   excluded pairwise    status in rules.exclusion.statuses plus transport_error and
#                        infrastructure_error (DEC-0417), degraded: true (with
#                        --exclude-degraded true), and a scoring status whose primary is
#                        null (ungraded); the task-trial cell leaves BOTH arms of every
#                        comparison it is in; a cell holding a valid row (a rerun) is valid
#   cap_failure          0 on every applicable primary (pass rate 0, every defect missed)
#   completed, agent_error  score what the row holds (hidden_test_pass_rate; defects)
#   The sensitivity figure repeats the comparison with cap_failure excluded pairwise
#   instead of scored 0; no decision reads it.
#
# Statistics (pre-registered in the suite's rules block; formulas in the Method section):
#   pass rate unit  the task: per task, the mean over its valid trials, arm minus a1_full
#   catch-rate unit the defect: per review-catch task and defect dK, the share of the
#                   arm's valid trials that caught it, arm minus a1_full; per-defect ids
#                   come from the row's `defects_missed` (or `recall.missed`) list of dK
#                   ids when present, else each defect of the task takes the row's
#                   defect_catch_rate (aggregate rows); the task-level figure is also
#                   reported (rules.bootstrap.also_report) and decides nothing
#   interval        percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference: `resamples`
#                   resamples with replacement, linear interpolation between order
#                   statistics, [lo, hi] = the (1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2 quantiles
#   d               the mean of the paired differences (not the bootstrap mean)
#   c, w            cost and wall-clock delta in percent against a1_full,
#                   (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100, over the per-task means of the
#                   cells the primaries paired
#   MDE             (z(1−(1−level)/2) + z(0.90)) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n): the smallest
#                   true mean difference a paired test at the report level detects with 0.90
#                   power at the available n; n < 2 → n/a
#   comparisons     every predicate compares values rounded to 9 decimals, so a planted
#                   −0.03 reads −0.03 and not −0.030000000000000027
#
# Decision per arm (rules.predicates, first match, DEC-0416, with DEC-0393's guard first):
#   the degradation guard (excluded share > rules.exclusion.inconclusive_above_share →
#   inconclusive, labelled Inconclusive-by-degradation, whatever the interval) →
#   investigate → keep → inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair) → remove → simplify. Then: an arm named by --cuts / --not-run reads
#   Not run (cut) or Inconclusive-by-power with the lead's figure; an arm whose MDE on an
#   applicable primary exceeds rules.mde_cut and whose predicate outcome is remove or
#   simplify reads Inconclusive-by-power with the figure (a null result the sample could
#   not have detected); A8 (absent: true) reads component-absent with the suite evidence.
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  report written
#   1  --partial and no decidable comparison (the report is still written)
#   2  usage error, unreadable input, unknown schema major, provenance conflict
#
# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-report.bats (planted rows generated by
# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py).
# =============================================================================
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import random
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

VERSION = "1.0.0"
REPORT_SCHEMA = 1
ROW_SCHEMA_MAJOR = 1
MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MAJOR = 1
CONTROL = "a1_full"
BARE = "a0_bare"
SENSITIVITY_ARM = "a4_no_gates"
BUILD_TYPES = ("feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor")
REVIEW = "review-catch"
PASS = "hidden_test_pass_rate"
CATCH = "defect_catch_rate"
DEC0417_EXCLUDED = ("transport_error", "infrastructure_error")
SCORING = ("completed", "agent_error", "cap_failure")
POWER = 0.90
DISPLAY = {"investigate": "Investigate", "keep": "Keep", "inconclusive": "Inconclusive",
           "remove": "Remove", "simplify": "Simplify", "not_run_cut": "Not run (cut)",
           "inconclusive_by_power": "Inconclusive-by-power", "component_absent": "component-absent",
           "no_rows": "no rows"}
PARTIAL_LINE = "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"
SENS_LABEL = "sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this"


class Fail(Exception):
    pass


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- small helpers
def r9(x):
    return None if x is None else round(x, 9)


def mean(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None


def f3(x):
    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:+.3f}" if x != 0 else "0.000"


def u3(x):
    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.3f}"


def pct(x):
    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:+.1f} %"


def j6(x):
    return None if x is None else round(x, 6)


def schema_major(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
        return int(v)
    if isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch(r"\d+(\.\d+)*", v):
        return int(v.split(".")[0])
    return None


def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
    n = len(sorted_xs)
    if n == 0:
        return None
    pos = q * (n - 1)
    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
    frac = pos - lo
    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac


def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
    if not diffs:
        return None, None
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = len(diffs)
    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)


def mde(diffs, level):
    if len(diffs) < 2:
        return None
    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))


def collapse(run_ids):
    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
    groups, other = {}, []
    for rid in run_ids:
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*-t)(\d+)", rid)
        if m:
            groups.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(int(m.group(2)))
        else:
            other.append(rid)
    out = []
    for prefix in sorted(groups):
        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))
        if len(ns) == 1:
            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
        else:
            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))
    return out + sorted(other)


def md_cell(s):
    return str(s).replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- inputs
def load_suite(path):
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            raw = fh.read()
    except OSError as e:
        raise Fail(f"cannot read suite {path}: {e.strerror}")
    try:

#                      [--exclude-degraded true|false] [--partial]
#                      [--cuts F] [--not-run CSV]
#

#                       and must carry schema_version 1 (an integer, or a "1.x" string);
#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).

#                       The Method section quotes its `rules:` block verbatim.

#   --json F            the JSON twin (schema_version 1)
#   --seed N            bootstrap seed (default 20261015); every interval uses its own

BARE = "a0_bare"

REVIEW = "review-catch"

SCORING = ("completed", "agent_error", "cap_failure")

def r9(x):
    return None if x is None else round(x, 9)


def mean(xs):

def f3(x):

def u3(x):

def pct(x):

def schema_major(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
        return int(v)
    if isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch(r"\d+(\.\d+)*", v):
        return int(v.split(".")[0])
    return None


def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
    n = len(sorted_xs)
    if n == 0:
        return None
    pos = q * (n - 1)
    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
    frac = pos - lo
    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac


def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
    if not diffs:
        return None, None
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = len(diffs)
    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)


def mde(diffs, level):
    if len(diffs) < 2:

    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

    groups, other = {}, []

def interval(p):
    if p is None or p["n"] == 0:
        return "no pair"
    return f"{f3(p['d'])} [{f3(p['lo'])}, {f3(p['hi'])}]"


def comp_json(p):
    out = {k: p[k] for k in ("metric", "control", "unit", "n", "n_tasks", "unpaired", "dropped", "defect_identity")}
    out.update({k: j6(p[k]) for k in ("d", "lo", "hi", "mde", "half_width")})
    out["pairs"] = [{"task_id": x["task_id"], "arm_value": j6(x["arm_value"]), "control_value": j6(x["control_value"]),
                     "diff": j6(x["diff"]), "defects": x.get("defects"),
                     "arm_runs": x["arm_runs"], "control_runs": x["control_runs"]} for x in p["pairs"]]
    if "task_level" in p:
        out["task_level"] = {k: (j6(v) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in p["task_level"].items()}
    return out


def build(args):
    suite, rules_text = load_suite(args.suite)
    rules = suite["rules"]
    bs = rules.get("bootstrap") or {}
    pre_res, pre_lvl = bs.get("resamples", 10000), bs.get("level", 0.90)
    if args.resamples is None:
        args.resamples = int(pre_res)
    if args.level is None:
        args.level = float(pre_lvl)
    if args.resamples < 1 or not (0.0 < args.level < 1.0):
        raise Fail("--resamples must be >= 1 and --level in (0, 1)")
    rows, dups = load_rows(args.runs)
    mans = load_manifests(args.manifests)
    arms = [a for a in suite["arms"] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")]
    arm_ids = [a["id"] for a in arms]
    labels = {str(a.get("label", a["id"])).upper(): a["id"] for a in arms}
    cuts = load_cuts(args.cuts, args.not_run, set(arm_ids), labels)
    for need in (CONTROL, BARE):
        if need not in arm_ids:
            raise Fail(f"suite has no arm {need}")

    main = Analysis(suite, rows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False)
    sens = Analysis(suite, rows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True)
    components = [a["id"] for a in arms if a["id"] not in (CONTROL, BARE) and not a.get("absent")]
    absent = [a for a in arms if a.get("absent")]
    seed = args.seed
    decisions = [main.arm_report(a, cuts, seed) for a in components]
    sens_rows = [sens.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components]

    h1_comps = [main.compare(CONTROL, BARE, m, seed) for m in main.primaries(CONTROL)]
    h1_ok = any(p["n"] > 0 and r9(p["lo"]) > 0 for p in h1_comps)
    h1_line = "H1: established" if h1_ok else "H1: not established — halt before promotion"
    a4 = None
    if SENSITIVITY_ARM in main.arms:
        a4 = main.compare(SENSITIVITY_ARM, CONTROL, PASS, seed)
        a4_ok = a4["n"] > 0 and r9(a4["hi"]) < 0
    else:
        a4_ok = False
    a4_line = ("A4 sensitivity: holds" if a4_ok
               else "A4 sensitivity: fails — harden tasks before acting on other arms")
    decidable = (any(d["decidable"] for d in decisions) or all(p["n"] > 0 for p in h1_comps)
                 or (a4 is not None and a4["n"] > 0))

    k = len(components)
    efp = k * (1.0 - args.level) / 2.0
    efp_line = (f"Expected false positives at level {args.level:.2f} over {k} components: "
                f"{k} × (1 − {args.level:.2f}) / 2 = {efp:.1f} one-sided per direction "
                f"({2 * efp:.1f} in either direction); no multiple-comparison correction is applied "
                f"(multiple_comparisons: {rules.get('multiple_comparisons', 'none')}).")

    # provenance
    used = [m for b, m in sorted(mans.items()) if any(r["batch"] == b for r in rows)] or \
        [m for _, m in sorted(mans.items())]

    def distinct(key, rowkey=None):
        vals = {str(m.get(key)) for m in used if m.get(key) not in (None, "")}
        vals |= {str(r.get(rowkey or key)) for r in rows if r.get(rowkey or key) not in (None, "")}
        return sorted(vals)

    def cli(m):
        return m.get("cli_version") or (m.get("executor") or {}).get("cli_version")

    lines = []
    L = lines.append
    L("# Loa 2.0 component ablation — report")
    L("")
    if args.partial:
        L(f"**{PARTIAL_LINE}**")
        L("")
    L(f"- report schema_version {REPORT_SCHEMA}; ablation-report.py {VERSION}")
    L(f"- suite: `{args.suite}` (name {suite.get('name', 'n/a')}, suite_version {suite.get('suite_version', 'n/a')})")
    L(f"- row suite_version: {', '.join(distinct('suite_version')) or 'n/a'}")
    L(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(distinct('source_commit')) or 'n/a'}")
    shas = distinct("suite_manifest_sha256")
    L(f"- suite manifest sha256: {', '.join(shas) or 'n/a'}" + (" — DRIFT: more than one" if len(shas) > 1 else ""))
    L(f"- image digest(s): {', '.join(distinct('image_digest')) or 'n/a'}")
    L(f"- cli_version(s): {', '.join(sorted({str(cli(m)) for m in used if cli(m)})) or 'n/a'}")
    L("- batches:")
    for b, m in sorted(mans.items()):
        n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["batch"] == b)
        L(f"  - `{b}`{' (smoke: listed, never decided)' if m.get('smoke') is True else ''}: {n} rows, "
          f"shuffle_seed {m.get('shuffle_seed', 'n/a')}, pre_registration_ref {m.get('pre_registration_ref', 'n/a')}, "
          f"source_commit {m.get('source_commit', 'n/a')}, image_digest {m.get('image_digest', 'n/a')}, "
          f"cli_version {cli(m) or 'n/a'}")

def write_out(path, text):
    if os.path.islink(path):
        raise Fail(f"refusing to write through the symlink {path}")
    parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if not os.path.isdir(parent):
        raise Fail(f"the directory of {path} does not exist")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {message}\n")
        sys.exit(2)


def main(argv):
    ap = Parser(prog="ablation-report.py", description="cycle-130 ablation report (see the header)")
    ap.add_argument("--runs", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--manifests", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--suite", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--json", dest="json_out")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261015)
    ap.add_argument("--resamples", type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=float)
    ap.add_argument("--exclude-degraded", choices=("true", "false"), default="true")
    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--cuts")
    ap.add_argument("--not-run")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    args.exclude_degraded = args.exclude_degraded == "true"
    try:
        text, data, decidable = build(args)
        write_out(args.out, text)
        if args.json_out:
            write_out(args.json_out, json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    except Fail as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {e}\n")
        return 2
    if args.partial and not decidable:
        sys.stderr.write("ablation-report.py: --partial: no comparison has a valid pair yet (report written)\n")
        return 1
    print(f"ablation-report.py: wrote {args.out}" + (f" and {args.json_out}" if args.json_out else ""))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

def interval(p):
    if p is None or p["n"] == 0:
        return "no pair"
    return f"{f3(p['d'])} [{f3(p['lo'])}, {f3(p['hi'])}]"


def comp_json(p):
    out = {k: p[k] for k in ("metric", "control", "unit", "n", "n_tasks", "unpaired", "dropped", "defect_identity")}
    out.update({k: j6(p[k]) for k in ("d", "lo", "hi", "mde", "half_width")})
    out["pairs"] = [{"task_id": x["task_id"], "arm_value": j6(x["arm_value"]), "control_value": j6(x["control_value"]),
                     "diff": j6(x["diff"]), "defects": x.get("defects"),
                     "arm_runs": x["arm_runs"], "control_runs": x["control_runs"]} for x in p["pairs"]]
    if "task_level" in p:
        out["task_level"] = {k: (j6(v) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in p["task_level"].items()}
    return out


def build(args):
    suite, rules_text = load_suite(args.suite)
    rules = suite["rules"]
    bs = rules.get("bootstrap") or {}
    pre_res, pre_lvl = bs.get("resamples", 10000), bs.get("level", 0.90)
    if args.resamples is None:
        args.resamples = int(pre_res)
    if args.level is None:
        args.level = float(pre_lvl)
    if args.resamples < 1 or not (0.0 < args.level < 1.0):
        raise Fail("--resamples must be >= 1 and --level in (0, 1)")
    rows, dups = load_rows(args.runs)
    mans = load_manifests(args.manifests)
    arms = [a for a in suite["arms"] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")]
    arm_ids = [a["id"] for a in arms]
    labels = {str(a.get("label", a["id"])).upper(): a["id"] for a in arms}
    cuts = load_cuts(args.cuts, args.not_run, set(arm_ids), labels)
    for need in (CONTROL, BARE):
        if need not in arm_ids:
            raise Fail(f"suite has no arm {need}")

    main = Analysis(suite, rows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False)
    sens = Analysis(suite, rows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True)
    components = [a["id"] for a in arms if a["id"] not in (CONTROL, BARE) and not a.get("absent")]
    absent = [a for a in arms if a.get("absent")]
    seed = args.seed
    decisions = [main.arm_report(a, cuts, seed) for a in components]
    sens_rows = [sens.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components]

    h1_comps = [main.compare(CONTROL, BARE, m, seed) for m in main.primaries(CONTROL)]
    h1_ok = any(p["n"] > 0 and r9(p["lo"]) > 0 for p in h1_comps)
    h1_line = "H1: established" if h1_ok else "H1: not established — halt before promotion"
    a4 = None
    if SENSITIVITY_ARM in main.arms:
        a4 = main.compare(SENSITIVITY_ARM, CONTROL, PASS, seed)
        a4_ok = a4["n"] > 0 and r9(a4["hi"]) < 0
    else:

    a4_line = ("A4 sensitivity: holds" if a4_ok

    shas = distinct("suite_manifest_sha256")
    L(f"- suite manifest sha256: {', '.join(shas) or 'n/a'}" + (" — DRIFT: more than one" if len(shas) > 1 else ""))
    L(f"- image digest(s): {', '.join(distinct('image_digest')) or 'n/a'}")
    L(f"- cli_version(s): {', '.join(sorted({str(cli(m)) for m in used if cli(m)})) or 'n/a'}")
    L("- batches:")
    for b, m in sorted(mans.items()):
        n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["batch"] == b)
        L(f"  - `{b}`{' (smoke: listed, never decided)' if m.get('smoke') is True else ''}: {n} rows, "
          f"shuffle_seed {m.get('shuffle_seed', 'n/a')}, pre_registration_ref {m.get('pre_registration_ref', 'n/a')}, "
          f"source_commit {m.get('source_commit', 'n/a')}, image_digest {m.get('image_digest', 'n/a')}, "
          f"cli_version {cli(m) or 'n/a'}")
    L(f"- rows read: {len(rows)} from {', '.join('`' + p + '`' for p in args.runs)}; "
      f"{len(main.listed)} listed and never decided; {len(dups)} duplicate run_id rows dropped")

    def mark(v, pre):
        return "" if v == pre else f" (NOT the pre-registered {pre})"

    L(f"- bootstrap: {args.resamples} resamples{mark(args.resamples, int(pre_res))}, level {args.level:.2f}"
      f"{mark(args.level, float(pre_lvl))}, seed {seed}; exclusion statuses "
      f"{', '.join(sorted(main.ex_statuses))}; degraded rows excluded: {str(args.exclude_degraded).lower()}")
    L("")
    L("## Decisions")
    L("")
    L("| component | arm | n pairs | pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI] (defects) | cost Δ % | "
      "wall-clock Δ % | excluded share | decision | rule matched | rows |")
    L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for d in decisions:
        cp = {p["metric"]: p for p in d["comparisons"]}
        npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
        catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else \
            f"{d['excluded_share']:.3f} ({d['excluded_cells']}/{d['cells_seen']})"
        dec = d["label"] + (f" — {d['figure']}" if d["figure"] else "")
        nrows = len(main.arm_rows.get(d["arm"], []))
        L(f"| {d['arm_label']} | `{d['arm']}` | {npairs} | {interval(cp.get(PASS))} | {catch} | {pct(d['c'])} | "
          f"{pct(d['w'])} | {share} | **{md_cell(dec)}** | {md_cell(d['rule'])} | {nrows} (§ Rows per cell) |")
    for a in absent:
        L(f"| {a.get('label', a['id'])} | `{a['id']}` | — | — | — | — | — | — | **component-absent** | "
          f"{md_cell(a.get('evidence', 'absent: true'))} | 0 |")
    L("")
    h1p = ", ".join(f"{p['metric']} {interval(p)} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})" for p in h1_comps)
    L(f"**{h1_line}** — a1_full − a0_bare: {h1p}. Rule (rules.h1): \"{rules.get('h1', '')}\"")
    L("")
    a4p = "no arm a4_no_gates" if a4 is None else f"{PASS} {interval(a4)} (n = {a4['n']} {a4['unit']})"
    L(f"**{a4_line}** — a4_no_gates − a1_full: {a4p}. Rule (rules.a4_sensitivity): "
      f"\"{rules.get('a4_sensitivity', '')}\"")
    L("")
    L(efp_line)
    L("")

    L("## Per-arm detail")
    L("")
    detail_arms = [BARE, CONTROL] + components
    metrics = {a: main.arm_metrics(a) for a in detail_arms if a in main.arms}
    by_arm = {d["arm"]: d for d in decisions}
    for a in detail_arms:
        if a not in main.arms:
            continue
        m = metrics[a]
        L(f"### {main.arms[a].get('label', a)} `{a}`")
        L("")
        L(f"- runs: {m['rows']} ({', '.join(f'{k} {v}' for k, v in m['by_status'].items()) or 'none'}); "
          f"degraded rows {m['degraded_rows']}; valid cells {m['valid_cells']}")
        share, ex, seen = main.excluded_share(a)
        L(f"- excluded cells: {ex} of {seen}" + ("" if share is None else f" (share {share:.3f})"))
        exl = [e for e in main.excluded if e["arm"] == a]
        for e in exl:
            L(f"  - `{e['run_id']}` {e['task_id']} t{e['trial']}: {e['reason']}")
        L(f"- applicable primaries: {', '.join(main.primaries(a))}")
        L(f"- {PASS} (task-mean of trial means, cap failures 0): {u3(m[PASS])}; "
          f"{CATCH}: {u3(m[CATCH])}")
        if a in by_arm:
            d = by_arm[a]
            for p in d["comparisons"]:
                L(f"- {p['metric']} vs a1_full: d [lo, hi] = {interval(p)}; n = {p['n']} {p['unit']} over "
                  f"{p['n_tasks']} tasks; MDE {u3(p['mde'])}; bootstrap half-width {u3(p['half_width'])}")
                if "task_level" in p:
                    tl = p["task_level"]
                    L(f"  - also_report (tasks, decides nothing): d [lo, hi] = "
                      f"{interval(dict(tl, n=tl['n']))}; n = {tl['n']} tasks")
                if p["defect_identity"]:
                    L(f"  - defect identity: {', '.join(p['defect_identity'])}")
                for u in p["unpaired"]:
                    L(f"  - left the pair: {u['task_id']} ({u['reason']})")
                for x in p["dropped"]:
                    L(f"  - pairwise drop: `{x['run_id']}` ({x['arm']}, {x['task_id']} t{x['trial']})")
            L(f"- cost Δ {pct(d['c'])}, wall-clock Δ {pct(d['w'])} over {d['cost_tasks']} paired tasks")
            L(f"- decision: **{d['label']}**" + (f" — {d['figure']}" if d["figure"] else "") + f"; rule: {d['rule']}")
            if d["state"] != d["predicate_state"]:
                L(f"- predicate outcome before the cut/power state: {d['predicate_label']}; "
                  f"{d['predicate_rule']}")
        L(f"- secondaries: verdict accuracy {u3(m['verdict_accuracy'])} (review {u3(m['verdict_accuracy_review'])}, "
          f"audit {u3(m['verdict_accuracy_audit'])}); regressions per run {u3(m['regressions_per_run'])}; "
          f"churn diff_lines {u3(m['diff_lines_per_run'])}, files_changed {u3(m['files_changed_per_run'])} per run")
        if m["false_positives_per_task"]:
            L("- false positives per review-catch task: " + ", ".join(
                f"{t} {u3(v)}" for t, v in m["false_positives_per_task"].items()))
        wall, tin, tout = m["wall_clock_ms_per_run"], m["tokens_in_per_run"], m["tokens_out_per_run"]
        wall_s = "n/a" if wall is None else f"{wall / 60000.0:.1f} min"
        tin_s = "n/a" if tin is None else f"{tin:.0f}"
        tout_s = "n/a" if tout is None else f"{tout:.0f}"
        L(f"- cost per task USD {u3(m['cost_per_task'])}, per run USD {u3(m['cost_per_run'])}; wall-clock per run "
          f"{wall_s}; tokens in/out per run {tin_s} / {tout_s}")
        L("")

    L("## Exclusions")
    L("")
    if main.excluded:
        L("| run_id | arm | task | trial | status | reason |")
        L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for e in sorted(main.excluded, key=lambda e: (e["arm"], e["task_id"], e["trial"], e["run_id"])):
            L(f"| `{e['run_id']}` | `{e['arm']}` | {e['task_id']} | {e['trial']} | {e['status']} | {md_cell(e['reason'])} |")
    else:
        L("No row was excluded.")
    L("")
    caps = [c["valid"] for (_, _), trials in sorted(main.cells.items()) for _, c in sorted(trials.items())
            if c["valid"] is not None and c["valid"]["status"] == "cap_failure"]
    L("### Cap failures (scored 0 on every applicable primary; the sensitivity figure excludes them)")
    L("")
    for r in caps:
        L(f"- `{r['run_id']}` (`{r['arm']}`, {r['task_id']} t{r['trial']}, cap_phase {r.get('cap_phase') or 'n/a'}, "
          f"USD {float(r.get('cost_usd') or 0):.2f})")
    if not caps:
        L("- none")
    L("")
    L("### Rows listed, never decided")
    L("")
    if main.listed or dups:
        for r, why in main.listed:
            L(f"- `{r['run_id']}` (`{r['arm']}`, {r['task_id']}, {r['status']}): {why}")
        for dd in dups:
            L(f"- `{dd['run_id']}` at {dd['dropped']}: duplicate run_id, the row at {dd['kept']} is used")
    else:
        L("None.")
    L("")

    L("## Cuts")
    L("")
    pw = [d for d in decisions if d["state"] == "inconclusive_by_power" and d["arm"] not in cuts]
    if not cuts and not pw:
        L("- none recorded")
    for a in sorted(cuts):
        c = cuts[a]
        L(f"- `{a}`: {DISPLAY[c['state']]} — reason: {c['reason']}; figure: {c['figure']} ({c['source']})")
    for d in pw:
        L(f"- `{d['arm']}`: Inconclusive-by-power from the rows — {d['figure']}")
    L(f"- cut ladder (suite): {'; '.join(suite.get('cut_ladder') or []) or 'n/a'}")
    L("")

    L(f"## Sensitivity figure: {SENS_LABEL}")
    L("")
    L("| component | arm | n pairs | pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI] (defects) | cost Δ % | "
      "wall-clock Δ % | excluded share | predicate outcome (not used) |")
    L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for d in sens_rows:
        cp = {p["metric"]: p for p in d["comparisons"]}
        npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
        catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else f"{d['excluded_share']:.3f}"
        L(f"| {d['arm_label']} | `{d['arm']}` | {npairs} | {interval(cp.get(PASS))} | {catch} | {pct(d['c'])} | "
          f"{pct(d['w'])} | {share} | {d['predicate_label']} |")
    L("")

    L("## Rows per cell")
    L("")
    for d in decisions:
        for p in d["comparisons"]:
            if not p["pairs"]:
                continue
            L(f"### {d['arm_label']} `{d['arm']}` — {p['metric']}")
            L("")
            L("| task | arm value | a1_full value | diff | arm rows | a1_full rows |")
            L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
            for x in p["pairs"]:
                L(f"| {x['task_id']} | {u3(x['arm_value'])} | {u3(x['control_value'])} | {f3(x['diff'])} | "
                  f"{', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['arm_runs']))} | "
                  f"{', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['control_runs']))} |")
            L("")
    for title, comps in (("H1 a1_full − a0_bare", h1_comps), ("A4 a4_no_gates − a1_full", [a4] if a4 else [])):
        for p in comps:
            if not p["pairs"]:
                continue
            L(f"### {title} — {p['metric']}")
            L("")
            L("| task | diff | arm rows | control rows |")
            L("|---|---|---|---|")
            for x in p["pairs"]:
                L(f"| {x['task_id']} | {f3(x['diff'])} | {', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['arm_runs']))} | "
                  f"{', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['control_runs']))} |")
            L("")

    L("## Method")
    L("")
    L(f"The pre-registered rules block of `{args.suite}`, quoted verbatim:")
    L("")
    L("```yaml")
    L(rules_text)
    L("```")
    L("")
    L("- Pass rate: the unit is the task; a cell is one task-trial; a task's value is the mean of its valid "
      "trials (cap_failure scores 0); a trial excluded in either arm leaves both arms of that comparison "
      "(pairwise); a task with no valid cell in either arm leaves the pair and is listed.")
    L("- Catch rate: the unit is the defect (task × dK); a defect's value is the share of the arm's valid trials "
      "that caught it (ids from the row's defects_missed / recall.missed, else the row's defect_catch_rate for "
      "every defect of the task); the task-level figure is also reported and decides nothing.")
    L(f"- Interval: percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference, {args.resamples} resamples with "
      f"replacement from random.Random({seed}) (one generator per interval), linear interpolation between "
      f"order statistics, [lo, hi] at the {(1 - args.level) / 2:.2f} and {1 - (1 - args.level) / 2:.2f} quantiles; "
      "d is the mean of the paired differences.")
    L("- c and w: (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100 over the per-task means of the paired cells (cost_usd, "
      "wall_clock_ms).")
    L(f"- MDE: (z({1 - (1 - args.level) / 2:.2f}) + z({POWER:.2f})) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n); an arm whose "
      f"predicates read remove or simplify with an MDE above mde_cut ({rules.get('mde_cut', 'n/a')}) reads "
      "Inconclusive-by-power.")
    L("- Predicates are evaluated in order on values rounded to 9 decimals, the degradation guard first "
      f"(excluded share > {main.guard:g} reads Inconclusive-by-degradation whatever the interval, DEC-0393), then "
      "investigate, keep, inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair), remove, simplify; Inconclusive-by-degradation is the "
      "inconclusive outcome whose excluded-share clause matched.")
    L("")

    data = {
        "schema_version": REPORT_SCHEMA, "generator": f"ablation-report.py {VERSION}", "partial": bool(args.partial),
        "suite": {"path": args.suite, "name": suite.get("name"), "suite_version": suite.get("suite_version")},
        "provenance": {"source_commits": distinct("source_commit"), "suite_manifest_sha256": shas,
                       "suite_versions": distinct("suite_version"), "image_digests": distinct("image_digest"),
                       "batches": [{"batch": b, "smoke": m.get("smoke") is True, "shuffle_seed": m.get("shuffle_seed"),
                                    "pre_registration_ref": m.get("pre_registration_ref"),
                                    "source_commit": m.get("source_commit"), "image_digest": m.get("image_digest"),
                                    "cli_version": cli(m), "manifest": m["_path"]} for b, m in sorted(mans.items())]},
        "bootstrap": {"resamples": args.resamples, "level": args.level, "seed": seed},
        "exclude_degraded": bool(args.exclude_degraded),
        "decisions": [{"arm": d["arm"], "arm_label": d["arm_label"], "label": d["label"], "state": d["state"], "rule": d["rule"],
                       "figure": d["figure"], "predicate_state": d["predicate_state"],
                       "predicate_rule": d["predicate_rule"], "primaries": d["primaries"],
                       "c": j6(d["c"]), "w": j6(d["w"]), "cost_tasks": d["cost_tasks"],
                       "excluded_share": j6(d["excluded_share"]), "excluded_cells": d["excluded_cells"],
                       "cells_seen": d["cells_seen"], "mde_flag": d["mde_flag"], "decidable": d["decidable"],
                       "comparisons": [comp_json(p) for p in d["comparisons"]]} for d in decisions],
        "absent": [{"arm": a["id"], "label": a.get("label"), "state": "component_absent",
                    "evidence": a.get("evidence")} for a in absent],
        "h1": {"line": h1_line, "established": h1_ok, "rule": rules.get("h1"),
               "comparisons": [comp_json(p) for p in h1_comps]},
        "a4": {"line": a4_line, "holds": a4_ok, "rule": rules.get("a4_sensitivity"),
               "comparison": comp_json(a4) if a4 else None},
        "expected_false_positives": {"components": k, "per_direction": j6(efp), "line": efp_line},
        "arms": {a: {kk: (j6(v) if isinstance(v, float) else
                          ({t: j6(x) for t, x in v.items()} if kk == "false_positives_per_task" else v))
                     for kk, v in metrics[a].items()} for a in metrics},
        "exclusions": sorted(main.excluded, key=lambda e: (e["arm"], e["task_id"], e["trial"], e["run_id"])),
        "listed": [{"run_id": r["run_id"], "arm": r["arm"], "task_id": r["task_id"], "status": r["status"],
                    "reason": why} for r, why in main.listed],
        "duplicates": dups,
        "cap_failures": [r["run_id"] for r in caps],
        "cuts": [dict(arm=a, **cuts[a]) for a in sorted(cuts)],
        "sensitivity": {"label": SENS_LABEL,
                        "rows": [{"arm": d["arm"], "predicate_state": d["predicate_state"], "c": j6(d["c"]),
                                  "w": j6(d["w"]), "excluded_share": j6(d["excluded_share"]),
                                  "comparisons": [comp_json(p) for p in d["comparisons"]]} for d in sens_rows]},
    }
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n", data, decidable


def write_out(path, text):
    if os.path.islink(path):
        raise Fail(f"refusing to write through the symlink {path}")
    parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if not os.path.isdir(parent):
        raise Fail(f"the directory of {path} does not exist")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {message}\n")
        sys.exit(2)


def main(argv):
    ap = Parser(prog="ablation-report.py", description="cycle-130 ablation report (see the header)")
    ap.add_argument("--runs", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--manifests", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--suite", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--json", dest="json_out")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261015)
    ap.add_argument("--resamples", type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=float)
    ap.add_argument("--exclude-degraded", choices=("true", "false"), default="true")
    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--cuts")
    ap.add_argument("--not-run")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    args.exclude_degraded = args.exclude_degraded == "true"
    try:
        text, data, decidable = build(args)
        write_out(args.out, text)
        if args.json_out:
            write_out(args.json_out, json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    except Fail as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {e}\n")
        return 2
    if args.partial and not decidable:
        sys.stderr.write("ablation-report.py: --partial: no comparison has a valid pair yet (report written)\n")
        return 1
    print(f"ablation-report.py: wrote {args.out}" + (f" and {args.json_out}" if args.json_out else ""))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

# =============================================================================
# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
#
# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
#
# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
# task_types against the known types).
#
# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
# =============================================================================
name: ablation-2.0
version: 1
source_commit: "ba11b860"   # the pin: the Sprint 259 completion tree (rc.5 + the #1267 mount fix + the harness; .claude/ identical to the Sprint 258 completion tree, DEC-0529; the per-batch .claude/ delta vs 4d69c3c4 is in MANIFEST.json, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 1
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
  predicates:                                # DEC-0416, DEC-0393, DEC-0530; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %; evaluated in this order
    inconclusive_by_degradation: "the arm's excluded share > 0.25 (whatever its interval; DEC-0393)"
    investigate: "else any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or no valid pair"
    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run
====ROW
  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
  # an unparseable timestamp (empty, an offset other than Z, not a string) is null, never an abort
  def ms(ts): if ts == null or ts == "" then null
              else (try (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) catch null) end;
  def obj: if type == "object" then . else {} end;
  def boolish: if type == "boolean" then . else null end;
  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
      (e.verdict_quality | obj) as $vq
      | {planned: ($vq.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
         completed: ($vq.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
         quality: ($vq.status // e.status // null),
         companion_planned: first((e.metadata | objects | .companion_voice | objects | .planned), null)} end;
  $p_f[0] as $p | $task_f[0] as $task | $g_f[0] as $g | $m_f[0] as $m | $minv_f[0] as $minv
  | $er_f[0] as $er | $ea_f[0] as $ea | $dot_f[0] as $dot | $bash_f[0] as $bashref | $mm_f[0] as $mismatch
  | ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
  | [ $ran[] as $ph
      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
      | $ph + {
          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
          # DEC-0545: a substitution (the requested model absent from a non-empty models_used)
          # degrades; an extra model beside the requested one is telemetry
          model_missing: ( ($ph.models_used // {} | objects // {}) as $mu
                           | if ($mu | length) > 0 and ($ph.model_requested | type) == "string" and $ph.model_requested != ""
                                and ([$mu | keys[] | norm_model] | any(. == ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) | not)
                             then [$mu | keys | join(", ")] else [] end )
        } ] as $phases
  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
        | .model_requested as $req
        | ( .model_missing[] | "\($l): requested \($req) absent from models_used (\(.))" ),
          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
          | voices($e) as $v
          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
    ) as $why
  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
     else $pst end) as $status
  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
====OUT
